fields.title: Yellow Pages Indonesia record
fields.description: Dataset envelope (_input / _source / _scrapedAt / recordType) wrapped around the site's own field shape. One row per business, company, product, market-insight or geo node; ERROR rows carry _error instead of a payload. Split a run by recordType. Unlisted fields pass through rather than failing the run.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The keyword, slug, URL or province code that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-listing-search, S2-category-page, S3-profile, S4-product-search, S5-facets or S6-citymap.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

recordType.title: Record type
recordType.description: BUSINESS, COMPANY, PRODUCT, MARKET_INSIGHT, GEO_NODE or ERROR.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Failure rows only: not_found, no_results, unresolvable_input, BlockedError or UnexpectedShape.

_warning.title: Warning
_warning.description: Non-fatal note, e.g. upstream_page_cap_reached when the 250-row ceiling truncated the query.

_enriched.title: Enriched
_enriched.description: True when the company's profile page was merged into this listing row.

entryId.title: Entry ID
entryId.description: Listing identifier. Numeric for claimed company pages, IDEN-prefixed for phone-directory records.

entryType.title: Entry type
entryType.description: COMPANY (claimed profile page) or PHONE_LISTING (phone-book record with no profile page).

companyId.title: Company ID
companyId.description: Numeric ID used in /profil-<id>-<slug>.html. Null for phone-directory entries.

description.title: Description
description.description: Company blurb; truncated with an ellipsis on listing pages.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: Primary phone number in the site's display format.

phones.title: Phones
phones.description: Company details mode: every number with its label (Utama, WhatsApp, Seluler, Fax).

emails.title: Emails
emails.description: Email addresses recovered from Cloudflare's obfuscated markup. Often empty - most listings publish no email.

website.title: Website
website.description: External website as published by the business. Passed through verbatim, so occasional malformed values from upstream appear as-is.

categorySlug.title: Category slug
categorySlug.description: Category inferred from a phone-directory entry's URL.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Company details mode: category slugs and names assigned to the company.

geo.title: Coordinates
geo.description: latitude / longitude. Present on listing rows; profile pages publish no coordinates, so enrichment preserves the listing value.

foundedYear.title: Founded year
foundedYear.description: Company details mode: 'Tahun pendirian' as published.

productId.title: Product ID
productId.description: Product search mode: numeric ID from /product-<slug>_<id>.html.

priceValue.title: Price
priceValue.description: Product search mode: numeric price as printed.

priceCurrency.title: Currency
priceCurrency.description: Product search mode: USD, IDR or Rp.

companyName.title: Seller name
companyName.description: Product search mode: the company offering the product.

companyUrl.title: Seller URL
companyUrl.description: Product search mode: the seller's profile URL.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Market insights mode: the keyword these facets describe.

advertisedTotal.title: Advertised total
advertisedTotal.description: Hit count the site prints. Marketing figure - only the first 250 rows are actually reachable.

reachableTotal.title: Reachable total
reachableTotal.description: Rows a single query can actually return (250).

regions.title: Regions
regions.description: Market insights mode: province name, listing count and the region filter value to pass back in.

cities.title: Cities
cities.description: Market insights mode: city name, listing count and the city filter value. In Geo directory mode, the province's cities.

similarKeywords.title: Similar keywords
similarKeywords.description: Market insights mode: related search terms the site suggests - useful for expanding a crawl.

provinceCode.title: Province code
provinceCode.description: Geo directory mode: two-digit province code.

cityCount.title: City count
cityCount.description: Geo directory mode: number of cities listed for the province.

detailUrl.title: Detail URL
detailUrl.description: Page this record was read from, on the data host.

yellowpagesUrl.title: Yellow Pages URL
yellowpagesUrl.description: The same page on www.yellowpages.id, for citation and manual checking.

sourceUrl.title: Source URL
sourceUrl.description: Resolved URL of the page this record was parsed from.
